Commentary.Commentary: Right then! England take the T20I series but India will look to forget this and look forward to the upcoming ODI series. The three-match series will start on Sunday, 18th September. The match will start at 3.30 pm IST (10 am GMT). Do join us early for the build up as well. Cheers!

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India says they were 20 runs short but credit to bowlers to take the game deep. Adds Radha Yadav always gives her best and applauds Richa Ghosh's performance as her cameo gave them to bowl something at. Tells they just want to stick to their strength and hopes to build more partnership in the future.

Sophia Dunkley is the Player of the Series. She says it's been a great series and she is happy to win despite missing a few big players. Adds that the players are stepping up. Reckons she likes to go hard in the first few overs. Says it will not happen overnight but she is working hard. tells she is excited for the upcoming World Cup with so many young players there.

Sophie Ecclestone is the Player of the Match. She says she is happy to take more responsibility. Adds that the rules have changed a little bit but she enjoys being the vice-captain and to learn things under Amy Jones. Tells that they are missing a few players but the youngsters are doing really well.
...Presentation coming up...

For England, a couple of batters got off to starts and that is what they needed chasing a small total. It was Sophia Dunkley at the start and Alice Capsey who played well to help her side over the line. Earlier in the day, after electing to bowl, England managed to restrict India to just over 120. It was a combined and excellent bowling performance and in reply, they chased the total quite easily.

For India, 122 was never going to be enough and they did not start all that well with the ball too. They leaked runs in the Powerplay and fell well behind in the game. Radha Yadav though did give her side a sniff by keeping it tight but even then they needed something magical which did not happen.

A convincing win in the end for England and they have sealed the T20I series. There was a moment where it seemed like India have a sniff but Alice Capsey and Bryony Smith played brilliantly to take England over the line.
FOUR! Capsey hits the winning runs! Full ball again on leg. Capsey sweeps it behind square on the leg side for four. England Women win by 7 wickets.
FOUR! Scores level! A full toss, angling on leg and Capsey pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Two more! Just 5 runs needed now! This is full and outside off. Smith smashes it over covers and long off comes across to save a couple.
Full ball, around off. Capsey lofts it to long off where Kaur is standing very straight. One.
This is working for Pooja! Angles a full ball, outside off. Capsey fails to hit it cleanly.
Very full and outside off. Capsey shuffles and looks to paddle it but mistimes it completely.
Full ball, outside off.  Capsey drags it to long on for a couple of runs now.
A length ball, angling outside off. Capsey mistimes her cut shot to point.
Two! On off, this is hit wide of long off for two.
12 needed now! On middle, Capsey looks to play the paddle scoop but it goes off the toe-end towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Just wide! A full toss outside off, Capsey hits it past cover and this one races away. Just the 13 needed now.
Outside off, Capsey looks to play the reverse sweep but misses. It goes just past the off pole.
A full toss, it is hit wide of long on for two.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Now singles will do it! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! A chance but not taken! Tough one but Dayalan Hemalatha should have done better! This is full and outside off, it is lofted towards deep cover. Dayalan Hemalatha is running towards the ball, she does not look convincing though and in the end, does not even reach it. It goes behind for a boundary too. She probably misjudged it.
Outside off, Smith slashes at it, she misses. It hits the pad and goes down to third man for one. Bye.
FOUR! That is a poor delivery and it has been put away! On the pads with fine leg and square leg in the ring. Bryony Smith whips it past the two and into the fence. 27 in 28 now.
Fuller and outside off, Smith hits it towards mid off.
A single to end! 31 needed in 30 balls. On middle, this is hit down towards long on for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
FOUR! There comes the pressure releaser! This is short and outside off, it is reverse swept past point and into the fence.
Just the one! On off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Another dot! A full toss, low, outside off, it is hit back to the bowler.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
Length ball, around off. Smith pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 38 runs needed in 36 bals.
Bangs a bouncer, around off. Smith leaves it alone. No wide given.
On middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length and on middle. Capsey drives back and Pooja Vastrakar dives to her right to stop.
On a length and around off. Capsey looks to drive but gets an inside edge and it rolls past the leg stump.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Pitched up on middle. Capsey chips it over mid-wicket, in the vacant area for four.
On middle, Smith punches it off the back foot to mid off.

OUT! BOWLED! Jones goes now! Yadav is pumped up! Tossed up, around off, this one skids through. Jones makes a bit of room as she tries to play the spin but plays the wrong line and the off pole is disturbed.
Tossed up, around off. Jones steps across and paddles it, through the keeper's leg for a couple of runs.
Tossed up on middle. Jones drives it to covers.
Too full and on off. Jones keeps it out
Full and outside off, it is driven to long off for one.
A single and Capsey will retain the strike! This is short and Capsey pulls it to deep mid-wicket.
This is short and wide and Capsey lets it go to the keeper.
Length ball, outside off. Capsey punches it through covers and collects two. Good running.
Full and outside off, pushed through covers for a single.

OUT! TIMBER! Dunkley goes on 49! India just getting in the game now! Still 51 runs needed! This is on a length and on middle. Dunkley has a big hoick across but misses and the stumps are disturbed. Dunkley was just struggling a bit here and she goes for one short of a deserving half-century.
Capsey is off the mark! Short of a length, outside off, it is hit to deep cover for one.
Outside off, Dunkley looks to go over long on but misses. End of a maiden by Radha Yadav, brilliant.
Another dot! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
That is nice and slow, it is well outside off, Dunkley looks to go down over long on but misses.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, this is slapped to cover.
Shorter and outside off, it is cut to point.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the fielder and India finally have something to be happy about! Tossed up on middle, this is dragged straight down to long on where Radha Yadav takes it. India need three or four more quickly. 53 needed.
Commentary.Howout: c Radha Yadav b Sneh Rana

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
2 more! Shorter and outside off, this is guided down to third man for two.
FOUR! That is a lovely sweep! On middle, this is hit behind square on the leg side. Away from the fielder for a boundary.
Three! Shorter and outside off, this is cut past point, it slows up as it gets to the ropes. Three taken.
Quick run! Shorter and on off, Wyatt chops it towards cover for one.
On middle, Wyatt plays it back to the bowler.
Shorter and on off, Wyatt plays it to point.
Outside off, Wyatt looks to sweep but misses.
Shorter and outside off, this is played through point for two.
On middle, the paddle scoop is out again, it is played fine on the leg side for two.
Outside off, this is swept towards deep square leg for one.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Outside off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Lands safed! Dunkley comes down the track and looks to go over mid-wicket but it goes off the top edge towards mid off for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped to cover.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Tossed up outside off, this is dragged towards deep mid-wicket for one. 50 up for England.
Shorter and outside off, Wyatt looks to cut but misses.
Looks to play the paddle sweep again, this is bowled wider outside off and it turns away too. It goes off the toe-end towards point for one.
Tossed up on off, Dunkley plays the paddle scoop fine on the leg side for two.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Dunkley misses out! A full toss on the pads, Dunkley hits it hard but to square leg.
FOUR! Slammed away! Outside off, Sophia Dunkley shuffles across and hits it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Two more! On middle, this is worked wide of the long on fielder for two.
An appeal in hope but nothing! That is off the bat! Dunkley comes down the track but yorks herself. She jams it out to short fine leg.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped to covers.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Full and outside off, pushed to mid off.
A single as this is hit to deep point.
On off, this is lofted to long off for one.
FOUR! England are playing with the field now! This is full and outside off. Dunkley drives it past covers. The fielder from long off comes across but fails to stop. A boundary.
Length and outside off, it is worked to point for one.
FOUR! Through the gap! Very full from Singh, around off. Wyatt hits it on the up but firmly in the gap to covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Placement! Too full and outside off. Dunkley goes across and whips it past mid on for four mour.
Sharma slows it up and serves outside off. Kept out.
FOUR! Freebie! A full toss on middle and Dunkley whacks it through mid-wicket, no chance for the fielder in the deep to cut it off. Four runs.
Two more! This is full and on middle. Dunkley inner edges her heave past square leg for two.
Just over! A flighted full ball, outside off. Dunkley comes down the track as she looks to go downtown but gets an outside edge over first slip for a couple.
Tossed up on middle. Dunkley tries to paddle but miscues it to mid-wicket.
Slower ball, outside off. Dunkley works it to extra cover. A misfield allows a single.
Too much width this time, outside off and it is cut to sweeper cover for one.
Outside off, this is cut again to point.
Full, slow and outside off, eased down to long off for one.
Singh gives width outside off. Dunkley slaps it but finds cover.
FOUR! First boundary of the chase! Short in length and outside off. Dunkley gets low and pulls it over mid-wicket for four.
Length ball, outside off. Wyatt cuts it to point.
Tossed up on middle, flicked past mid-wicket for one.
Good stop! Outside off, slapped hard to covers where the fielder dives to her right and saves a certain boundary.
Flatter, outside off, slower through the air. Blocked out.
This is way outside off, cut to deep cover for a single.
On the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
On middle, it is hit to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length and way outside off. Dunkley drills it wide of long off for a brace.
A length ball, outside off. Dunkley half-heartedly defends but misses.
Outside off on a length. Dunkley swings and misses.
This one nips back in, it is full and on middle. Wyatt looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge to square leg for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Dunkley slaps it to long off and gets off the mark with a single.
